title: Continuation of Nordheim Condensation Beyond Dirac-Mass Formation
exact_target: Determine whether the Nordheim evolution can continue after condensation as a zero-energy atom plus a regular energy-density component.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005626 (OWR-14297737-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Classical and Quantum Mechanical Models of Many-Particle Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/38, pp. 2179--2246. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: A measure-valued weak formulation is necessary at the atom. Conservation laws, positivity and any uniqueness claim must be justified in that formulation.
